create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs
set_and_get_graph_weights: set arc weights on a gtn Graph using a list or numpy array and retrieve them
create_scalar_graph: create a scalar gtn Graph from a single float weight value for autograd operations
run_backward_autograd_on_graphs: run gtn.backward on the result of gtn.add or gtn.negate to compute gradients
run_parallel_operations_on_graph_list: run gtn.add or gtn.negate in parallel over a list of gtn Graph objects
